run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the gtest group CC'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra recipients to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-adds the googletestframework mailing list to CC
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize upload_gtest.py which is a thin wrapper that passes CLI args to upload.py with a default CC group
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default CC recipients beyond the gtest group
